macros.name: mcheadrepeat
macros.doc: \mcheadrepeat prints the most recently declared heading again without forcing a column or page break.

macros.name: multicoltabpagebreak
macros.doc: Outside `multicols`, `\multicoltabpagebreak \\` forces the next page and repeats the heading.

envs.name: multicoltab
envs.doc: multicoltab provides a non-floating table environment whose source rows can continue in the next column of a multicols layout or on a later page.
